verdict.rationale: Cekura documents only one first-party alerting mechanism: scheduled cron jobs that run automated calls and alert you if they fail. Its homepage also claims live drift detection and issue flagging, but nothing shows user-configurable thresholds or named delivery channels. Missing for 10: configurable alert rules on error rates, cost-spike alerts, eval-score-drop thresholds on production calls, documented Slack/PagerDuty/email notification channels, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: Cron jobs run automated calls on a schedule to check the status of your agent and alert you if things fail.
Live drift detection across every call.
Cekura flags issues → reproduces in simulation → suggests fixes automatically.
